allow: PowerShell($dirs = 'bin','data','docs','fonts','nginx','scripts','sql','static','templates'; foreach \($d in $dirs\) { $p = "A:\\claud\\$d"; $items = Get-ChildItem -Force -Recurse $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $files = @\($items | Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer }\); $size = \($files | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum; "=== $d : $\($files.Count\) files, $\([math]::Round\($size/1MB,2\)\) MB ==="; $items | Select-Object -First 25 | ForEach-Object { "  " + $_.FullName.Substring\(9\) }; if \($items.Count -gt 25\) { "  ... +$\($items.Count - 25\) more" } })
